\c[6](I slammed open the door and saw a girl seemingly tied to a chair.)
\c[6](I was suddenly cut off by someone grabbing me from behind, holding my neck
with his arm to restrain me.)
Make a sound to alert the others and I’ll break your neck.
\c[6](The woman who was seemingly tied to the chair stood up, revealing the ties
were fake as she approached me- holding what looked like a pipe.)
\c[6](I felt the arm around my neck tighter, the girl chuckled slightly.)
Don’t get how this works yet, Sunshine?
You speak when *we* tell you to.
And if you’re lucky you’ll still be able to speak by the end of this.
If you’re a good pig and play nice, that is.
Let me make this clear- if you want to leave this… Mostly unharmed, you're going
to show us straight to the exit. No bullshit. No stalling. You help us, we help you.
And by the looks of it, you’ve not got much time huh?
Damn, must suck to be you.
So what’s it gonna be? Show us the gates or you see the pearly gates?
I… I don’t know where the exit is!
Bullshit, don’t you even *try* that with us.
You’re starting to piss me off, which is dangerous for a little guy like you.
You know what we do to little guys like you?
No-no! Seriously! I’m- I’m not the one behind this!
Dude, I don’t give a shit where you land on the kidnapper corporate ladder.
Doesn’t matter if it’s sausage, bacon, ham, it’s all pig in the end.
So are you gonna keep oinking, little guy? Or start giving us what we want?
I-... I’ve also been taken hostage! I’m with you guys! I don’t know what’s
Pfff- you really think that’s gonna work on us, sweetheart?
No-! No! I’m Shinku, Shinku Kutsuki! I’m an Ultimate too!
…Waiiiitt, hold on- Shit, no, he’s right. Release him.
Yeah no, his lonely ass was in the year above me- I remember seeing him around.
\c[6](Begrudgingly the man behind me let me go, I fell to the ground briefly but
I was able to pull myself up and brush off. Meanwhile the girl dropped the metal
Ow… Did you have to hold me so hard?
Shockingly I wasn’t intending on letting you go.
No hard feelings though, right? You get it? You seem cool like that,
And guess what? We grew from it, we learnt from it, you may call it ‘being threatened’
but I see it as ‘new life experience’.
I guess it’s fine… You’re probably just acting out given the circumstances.
What were you trying to do anyway?
Oh like, well- we’re both Ultimates so obviously they’re probably holding us
Spencers here thought it would be best to just bust out of here and try and
But I figured they’d want their cash cows in prime condition, so we staged an attack,
hoping to bait them in here to sneak up and threaten the captor until they let us out.
Instead of the kidnapper though it was just some dweeb.
Yeah, I know. I don’t care.
…Crazy how you’ve changed though, man- you look so different from back

Uh, I write novels. Crime Novels.
That’s pretty fucking gay, man. You should go to the gym or something, or just
\c[6](I'll just do what I usually do to deal with bullies.)
\c[6](Ignore them, don't give them attention and sleep peacefully at night
knowing I'll be successful my whole life, while they'll crashout in their 20s
and end up working at WcMonalds.)
Sorry, I’ve seen you around but I don’t think I ever got your name properly…
Lyra, Lyra Shatel. Crazy you haven’t heard of me, but I’ll give you a pass this time.
You were probably too busy writing some werewolf-alpha-omega-crime-shit to crash
Does Ultimate Debater ring a bell? I helped run the Student Radio too, I had this
show every week- man, it was sick.
No, but now I sort of wish I caught it… I didn’t even know we had a Student Radio.
Oh yeah, we did all sorts on it. Wednesdays were banging, we did BDSM sessions
You… You did BDSM on the radio??! They let you do that?
Yeah, duh. They were some of our most popular segments, everyone loved BDSM. \|
Bible Discussion and Study Meetings, they went hard.
God, what were you thinking I meant? Get your mind out the gutter, geez~
Please don’t tell me you’re one of those born-again bitches.
Ew, ‘course not. We usually just debated the meaning of verses and how they’d
been applied to inform politics throughout the years.
If I sing kumbaya it’s gonna be with Satan and his sin polycule, I’d have a wholleee
lotta praying to catch up on if I wanted the Big-J to want me in his crib.
It’s not like any of that shit is real, anyway.
It's just something poor people who hate their wives make up to feel better
Welp, since our plan was a bust I’m just gonna go.
Aw, c’mon. We can kick Shinku out and try again.
I don’t wanna have to sit here listening to your screeching just to catch some

I’m gonna find the prick behind this and get out of here, maybe I’ll catch you
Wait, can I get your name before you go?
What? Why’d you even need it?
Oh, just uh- to tell the others you’re here, put a name to a face.
I don’t plan on stickin’ around enough for a mothers meeting with anyone here.
Please? It would just take a moment, it would help a lot.
Noneya business, Jackass. Go write about teens kissing to make up for
\c[6](The guy pretty quickly left, leaving me and Lyra in the room alone,
she seemed to roll her eyes as he left.)
Sorry ‘bout him, he gets all cranky when he hasn’t had a snack.
Uh… It’s fine, do you know him?
Eh, not really. I’d heard of him before. But like- just properly met him here,
but nothing like a good ol’ bit of kidnapping to help you bond.
Surprised you haven’t heard of him though, he’s like- suuuuper famous, like mega
You seem like the type to like him.
Oh, I mean like, he takes his shirt off a lot. So y’know. Seems like your thing.
\c[6](...She’s reading something here and it’s not my books.)
It’s crazy though, if *I* take off my shirt in front of a crowd of people it’s a

But seriously, don’t sweat over him being an ass to you. He’s probably just on

Ish-you, not an ish-me sorta deal.
It’s whatever… Wait, you mentioned others right? Are there a load of us
Oh, right! Yes uh- there’s a small group of us… I was actually looking for

Oh, shit, that’s convenient. I think this is some kinda medical room.
Hey, c’mon I think I saw some pills here-
\c[6](She moved to one of the cabinets and looked through it.)
Oh, sweet- they’ve got xanax here too.
Uh… Why would you need Xanax?
Girl, we’re kidnapped, why wouldn’t I need xanax?
\c[6](I don’t exactly follow the logic here…)
Anywayyy- here you go, one of these has gotta work.
Now we’ve got ‘em, we oughta motor quickly to make sure we don’t keep ‘em waiting.
Right, yeah- thank you, again. You didn’t have to do this.
Oh, you think I’m doing this for free? Cute.
Don’t even worry about it, Sunshine. Let’s bounce!
\c[6](There's a load of bears and dolls in this prison... Who exactly did they hold here?)
\c[6](...Just like the ones Akari used to have.)
\c[6]('My dearest, I apologise for my previous lapse in judgement-')
\c[6]('I was briefly hysterical but I have recovered.')
\c[6]('I can't recall the last time I saw a warden...')
\c[6]('The food is dwindling, some prisoners have resorted to eating the plants-')
\c[6]('Others the pills... Which may explain their behaviour.')
\c[6]('But they will come back soon, I am certain.')
\c[6]('Oedipus Complex? I think you'll find it's rather simple.')
\c[6]('I am ill. I am very, very ill.')
\c[6]('The wallpaper keeps curling and laughing at me.')

\c[6]('You are dead and laughing at me, they call it mania, I know what I see.')
\c[6]('Do not mock me darling, I miss you dearly.')
\c[6]('Heyyy Sis, being a warden is pretty sick-')
\c[6]('But things have gotten a little complicated-')
\c[6]('Less and less real wardens are showing up day by day-')
\c[6]('And when they do show up they don't do their fucking jobs.')
\c[6]('They throw the dogs a bone and leave.')
\c[6]('But don't you worry! I'm completely okay.')
\c[6]('Can't wait to see you again, so we can have some fun.')
\c[6](Poisons, medications, first aid kits... all there.)

\c[6](It looks fairly unprofessional following the second half though.)
\c[6](Various Prisoner names and what they were perscribed...)
\c[6](Medicine supplies seemed to be dwindling, weird they're all restocked now.)
\c[6]('Miss Carmine, I have restocked the infirmary as you requested.')
\c[6]('But some of these pills are... Questionable, do you know what these are?')
\c[6]('Since you've dismissed my previous concerns I'll make it clear now:')
\c[6]('I was grateful you withdrew my status of prisoner.')
\c[6]('I do not say these things to criticise you or undermine that.')
\c[6]('As much as I disagree with your cause and resent your mocking of me-')
\c[6]('I'm starting to fear this is bigger than even your boss is prepared for.')
\c[6]('Kind regards, K.A (Head of cleaning and Maintenance (Janitor.)')
\c[6](Even more medicine, slightly reassuring that we have
some way of dealing with injuries.)
